setup.zh: 雨下了一夜。陈仓北坂的祠下有一个池，池里头一回有了水。夜里祠里的石头叫了一声，像雄鸡，野鸡都跟着叫。池底卧着一口鼎，鼎口插着一排律管，十二根，第一根空着。
setup.en: It rains all night. Under the shrine on Chencang's north slope is a pool, and for the first time it holds water. At night the stone in the shrine cries out once, like a cock, and the wild pheasants answer. At the bottom of the pool lies a cauldron, its mouth set with a row of pitch-pipes — twelve, the first one missing.

recap.zh: 雨落进陈宝祠下的池里；池底的鼎口插着十二根律管，第一根空着。
recap.en: Rain filled the pool under the Chenbao shrine; the cauldron at its bottom was set with twelve pitch-pipes, the first missing.

text.zh: 秦人把天下的尺、斗、秤都定成了一个。律也是——十二律，头一根定了，其余的才跟着定。
text.en: The men of Qin made every rule, measure and scale under heaven one. Pitch too — of the twelve pipes, the first is fixed and the rest follow from it.

alone.zh: 十二律，头一根定了，其余的才跟着定。
alone.en: Of the twelve pitch-pipes, the first is fixed and the rest follow from it.

label.en: Read the seal · The first pipe

exits.means: reads the seal, names the first of the twelve pitch-pipes

text.zh: 你说出它的名字。空着的地方长出一根竹管，风从池上吹过，十二根一齐响了。鼎口的气冲上来——是雨的味道，和雄鸡叫的味道。
text.en: You say its name. A bamboo pipe grows in the empty place; wind passes over the pool and all twelve sound together. The cauldron's breath rushes up — rain, and a cock's crow.

exits.means: tries to pull the pipes or pry the cauldron out by force

text.zh: 律管一根也拔不动。风一吹，只有十一个音。
text.en: Not one pipe will come loose. When the wind blows there are only eleven notes.
